backend/main.mo: Motoko backend exposing predictAdmission, computing approx rank from percentile and returning fixed college predictions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence listing frontend integration requirements and related files for backend predictor wiring.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing key frontend files and their roles in the predictor UI.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind base and color variable setup defining light/dark OKLCH palette.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML root file loading the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: App wrapper rendering the MHT-CET predictor form page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook creating and caching the backend actor instance, refetching when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication and identity lifecycle.
frontend/src/index.css: Alternate global Tailwind style sheet defining warm earth-tone color variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React entry point setting up QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/MhtCetPredictorFormPa: Full predictor form UI calling actor.predictAdmission, validating input, showing estimated rank and results.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, fonts, radii, animations, and enabling plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project’s versioned state, architecture notes, and implemented frontend features for an MHT-CET college predictor. Contains guidance for backend logic, data storage, and integration plans.
